blocks.text: A new provision (224(3A)) has been included in section 224, to allow the Registrar to extend any time necessary for doing a relevant act that may become necessary, in connection with a revocation of registration. However, this provision does not allow the Registrar to extend the time for the Registrar to give notice of the proposed revocation.
